order_note: Official printed order: Topics 1–8 statements, then core practicals and Appendix 6 mathematical skills. Legacy seed points are excluded from the order and from the tree.
year_basis: AS specification, "Progression from Advanced Subsidiary GCE to Advanced GCE": students "would have covered Topics 1-4 which are common to both qualifications but the additional topics 5-8 will need to be covered". Topics 1–4 are therefore Year 12 content and 5–8 Year 13.
